name: B10-0089/2024 (Verts/ALE) – Iraq, notably the situation of women’s rights and the recent proposal to amend the Personal Status Law
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Iraq, notably the situation of women’s rights and the recent proposal to amend the Personal Status Law
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law itself. It is stating its position on a proposed change to Iraq's Personal Status Law of 1959. That proposal would lower the minimum age of marriage for girls from 18 to 9 and for boys from 18 to 15, and would let religious institutions set their own rules on marriage, divorce and inheritance. The Parliament rejects the proposal and asks Iraq to withdraw it.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament only states its position and asks Iraq to withdraw the proposal.
- **Who it affects:** Women and girls in Iraq, through marriage, divorce and inheritance rules.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the European Union's institutions and to Iraq's parliament and government.
